title: FormProvider
subtitle: Context for useField / useFieldArray
description: Provide a form instance to context consumers.

signature.code:
function FormProvider<T>(props: { form: Form<T>; children: ReactNode }): JSX.Element
function useFormContext<T = any>(): Form<T>

content: `useFormContext` throws if no provider is present. Nest providers for multi-instance UIs (see Sharing patterns).
